verdict.rationale: Attio documents a native visual Workflows builder in which workspace members chain blocks without code, starting from triggers such as "When a new deal is created." The workflows page shows steps that enrich records and score and route leads to the right rep or channel, so trigger-based record updates are reasonably supported. Task creation and notification steps inside workflows are not shown; the SDK notifications doc covers in-app notices from apps, not workflow actions. missing for 10: documented create-task workflow action, documented send-notification workflow action (email/Slack/in-app), explicit catalog of record-update actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
